title: Tuning-Free Tests for Treatment Effect Heterogeneity via Expectile Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.25986v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops tuning-free tests for treatment effect heterogeneity. By characterizing the null hypothesis as constancy of the expectile treatment effect curve, we construct test statistics as continuous functionals of the mean-centered sample expectile process. We establish a uniform Bahadur representation, derive the asymptotic properties of the test statistics under the null and fixed alternatives, and show nontrivial power against local alternatives approaching the null at the $n^{-1/2}$ rate. For feasible inference, we develop a fast multiplier bootstrap that consistently approximates the nonpivotal null distribution while capturing the first order effect of estimating the unknown common shift. A key practical advantage of the procedure is that it is tuning-free, requiring no density or score function estimation, bandwidth selection, or repeated refitting. translated_title: 基于期望分位数过程的无调参处理效应异质性检验
translated_abstract: 本文开发了针对处理效应异质性的无调参检验方法。通过将原假设刻画为期望分位数处理效应曲线的恒定性，我们将检验统计量构造为去均值样本期望分位数过程的连续泛函。我们建立了一致的Bahadur表示，推导了检验统计量在原假设和固定备择假设下的渐近性质，并证明了对以n^{-1/2}速率趋近原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡功效。为实现可行的统计推断，我们开发了一种快速乘数自助法，该方法能够一致逼近非枢轴的原假设分布，同时捕捉估计未知共同位移的一阶效应。该方法的一个关键实践优势是无需调参，即不需要进行密度或得分函数估计、带宽选择或重复拟合。我们进一步引入逐点学生化方法，并针对经验集……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于期望分位数过程的无调参检验方法来检验处理效应异质性，无需密度估计、带宽选择或重复拟合，并通过快速乘数自助法实现计算高效且渐近有效的推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes tuning-free tests for treatment effect heterogeneity based on expectile processes, requiring no density estimation, bandwidth selection, or repeated refitting, and achieving fast, asymptotically valid inference via a multiplier bootstrap.
